title: Private native chunk logical quota extent header; no artifact/source/runtime/graph authority
$comment: Native maximum private allowance is1..603979776bytes (512MiB media plus64MiB auxiliary); current/source/processing recipe/local chunk/environment scope must be independently derived by the dispatcher. Filename .chunk-capacity-v1-<64scopehex>.bin under the native job retained store. Four-byte big-endian header byte length, exact canonical UTF8 header<=4096bytes, followed by sparse zero extent; logical file length=4+header_bytes+maximum_private_bytes. Existing alljob used_bytes counts its entire logical length alongside every old/undo/orphan/otherjob regular byte. Work root derives only from admitted output/.dubflow-review-candidates/<job_namespace>/chunk-capacity-v1-<scopehex>; no header path hint authorizes IO. Native control/work handles pin identity; control readonly/single-link/no-follow/header/size/sparse checks, actual work inventory<=4096entries/depth4/no-follow/regular/single-link and current bytes+requested additional<=allowance. Fresh native NTFS GUID/caller available>=additional+2GiB and shared32GiB quota checks on every callback. Capacity is logical quota; caller-free physical space is independently reobserved. Drop/crash preserves extent/work, live ownership refuses reacquisition, same native scope/header/limit/work identity may reopen after owner exit. Explicit release requires zero work files, deletes only its pinned quota control handle on Windows, preserves all workspace/media/evidence files and empty directories. No general cleanup/eviction or implicit repin/migration, source-QC-CAS/current render/public longform grant. Actual crash workflow and complete native processing integration remain mandatory.
